class.name: kontrolem_state_bridge/OdometryBaseBridge
class.description: ros2_control SensorInterface that subscribes to a base odometry topic (nav_msgs/Odometry) and re-exports it as the 13 floating-base scalar state interfaces on a <gpio> block, so base pose/twist from a non-custom producer (Gazebo ground truth, or a real estimator) enters the RT loop as claimable state interfaces exactly as BaseStateSensor expects.
